summary: STRYKOS iteration 3 full regression (backend + frontend). Backend: 25/25 new pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_strykos_iter3.py pass. Covered: admin credentials migration (new contact@actoos.com login works, admin@strykos.com returns 401); GET /api/settings exposes hero (interval_ms + 3 slides with video_url/image_url/title_fr/en/cta_link) and sections (categories/new_arrivals/promotions/best_sellers/featured each with video_url/image_url/tagline_fr/en); PUT /api/admin/settings for 'hero' and 'sections' persists and is restored after test; password reset: unknown email -> {ok:true}; registered fresh user -> {ok:true} + 'password_reset' row with to_email appears in /api/admin/emails with status sent (via real Emergent proxy), second request within 2 min silently rate-limited (no new log); POST /api/auth/reset-password with bad token -> 400 'Lien invalide ou expire'; password <8 chars -> 400; Reviews on /api/products/maillot-djoliba-local/reviews returns {count,average,distribution,reviews}; anon POST rejected (401); authenticated customer POST creates auto-approved review, same user re-posting returns updated:true with unchanged count; rating 6 -> 422, body too short -> 422; product detail now exposes rating_avg/review_count and product list items also include these fields; owner DELETE /api/reviews/{id} works; POST /api/reviews/upload accepts jpeg returns absolute http(s) url ending .jpg, rejects text/plain 400; Admin reviews: GET /api/admin/reviews includes product {name,slug}; PUT /admin/reviews/{id}/approve {approved:false} hides from public list; DELETE /admin/reviews/{id} works; CSV: anon GET /api/admin/export/{orders,stock}.csv -> 401, admin returns 200 text/csv with Content-Disposition attachment and proper French headers 'Numero;Date;Statut...' and 'SKU produit;Nom FR...', ?status=paid filter supported. Frontend (Playwright): Home hero-banner renders, hero-title changes after hero-next, hero-dots has 4 buttons (3 slides + play/pause), hero-prev returns to first slide; all 5 section banners (categories/new_arrivals/promotions/best_sellers/featured) are visible with poster images (video elements present; headless Chromium cannot decode H.264 so poster shown - expected per request). Login page shows forgot-password-link -> navigates to /forgot-password, submit shows forgot-sent confirmation; /reset-password?token=bad shows 'Lien invalide ou expire' toast; mismatched passwords show 'Les mots de passe ne correspondent pas' toast. Product page /product/maillot-djoliba-local: product-reviews visible with reviews-average '4.0', review-login-link shown when logged out, product-stars visible; registered fresh customer, write-review-btn opens review-form, review-rating-4 + review-body + submit-review-btn -> success toast ('Merci pour votre avis !') and review appears in reviews-list. Admin cockpit (contact@actoos.com / Salifkane&&7): /admin/settings settings-tab-hero shows hero-slides-editor + hero-interval + hero-slide-0..2; add-slide-btn increments to 4, remove-slide decrements back to 3; sections-editor exposes all 5 section-editor-* cards; settings-hero-save shows save toast. /admin/reviews lists reviews with toggle-review buttons; sidebar admin-nav-avis entry present. /admin/orders export-orders-csv triggers download 'strykos-commandes.csv'; /admin/products export-stock-csv triggers download 'strykos-stock.csv'. All CSV downloads verified via Playwright download event.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_router.py is now 818 LOC - still above 700 soft-limit; recommend splitting into orders/products/promos/customers/settings/exports/reviews sub-routers.
reviews_router.create_review: duplicate 'from utils import normalize_media' at function level while module already imports resolve_media - inline import is fine but inconsistent.
reviews_router.create_review verified_purchase computation runs two queries (count then items) - can be done in a single scalar query filtering by product_id in JSON items. Minor perf.

auth_router.forgot_password: 2-minute window is enforced in Python with a DB query; good. However the create vs commit race across two concurrent requests from same user could still send two emails. Consider a DB unique partial index or SELECT ... FOR UPDATE.
auth_router.reset_password: when token used/expired returns 'Lien invalide ou expire' (consistent); good anti-enumeration. Nit: no password_reset confirmation email after successful reset.
admin_router.export_orders: no pagination; a very large orders table would stream everything into memory before yielding. OK for current scale.
settings_router.public_settings leaks all enabled payment_providers details but strips keys/secrets properly. Verified.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (hero + sections, forgot/reset-password, product reviews write+delete, admin settings hero/sections editors + save, admin reviews list + nav, orders+stock CSV downloads)

context_for_next_testing_agent: iter3 regression at /app/backend/tests/test_strykos_iter3.py. Important session gotcha: /api/auth/login sets httponly cookie, so a shared requests.Session will become authenticated for subsequent anon negative tests - use a fresh requests.get/post without session for anon-rejection assertions (fixed in this file). Email log field is 'to_email' (not 'to'); /api/products returns {'total','page','limit','products':[...]} (list key is 'products', not 'items'). CSV endpoints verify via content-disposition + content-type + first-line header; UI download verified via page.expect_download. rca of the issue: No functional bugs found in iteration 3. Initial 3 test failures during authoring were test-side issues: (a) shared requests.Session retained auth cookie from previous admin login causing anon-rejection tests to receive 200 - fixed by using fresh requests.get/post; (b) /api/products response uses 'products' key not 'items'; (c) /api/admin/emails log entries use 'to_email' field not 'to'. All resolved; backend behaves correctly.
